headline: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in Cambridge Analytica case
summary: A New Mexico court ordered Meta to pay $25 billion in a case tied to the decade-old Cambridge Analytica scandal and a trial over its data privacy practices.

claims.statement: Meta was ordered to pay $25 billion in a case tied to the Cambridge Analytica scandal.

sources.quote: Meta ordered to pay $25 billion in case related to Cambridge Analytica scandal
